signature.one_line: One-take staged press-scrum announcement: top-band karaoke captions, spoken word accent, persistent CTA bar.
unique_devices: Staged press-scrum POV: foreground hands push phones and a round mic at the speaker, who steps into frame and addresses the 'press'
Top-band karaoke captions (16.7-23.4 % H): segment pre-laid out, words appear in their final slots, spoken word accent, earlier words white, unspoken words hidden
Thin white rounded CTA bar with small black text + contact, fixed at 72-74 % H for the whole clip
Single unbroken take with zero cuts or punch-ins; all motion is in the text
signature.why_it_works: An ordinary announcement staged as breaking news creates an instant 'who is this?' gap; speech starts on frame 2; the CTA never leaves.

hook.first_frame: POV from inside a crowd of hands holding phones and a round microphone toward an office glass door; the speaker is about to step into frame

structure.what: Speaker steps into the scrum and calms the 'press'
Confirms the announcement and its scope
Short invitation question to the viewer
Reads out how to apply (also on the CTA bar)

captions.how: Poppins 600 56 px lowercase, 4-7 words over max 2 lines, block centred at ~20 % H (line 1 ink 16.7-19.7 %, line 2 20.5-23.4 %), lines centred on x ~51 %, max width 71 % W; each word hard-cuts in accent on its frame, previous word turns white; segment change is a hard cut

background_text.how: White rounded rectangle x 17.2-78.5 %, y 72.1-74.2 % (2.1 % H), ~6 px radius; centred black Poppins 600 26 px line with a short CTA + heart emoji + contact; static, not tracked

layout.how: Face at ~38-55 % H, captions above the head, CTA bar below the chin line; foreground hands/phones/mic in the lower and side edges

camera.how: Slight handheld drift from inside the crowd, no punch-ins

case.normal: lowercase as transcribed; capital only for the first word of the video and proper nouns

captions_spec.punctuation: none (commas, full stops and '?' dropped); an email/URL keeps '@' and '.' and may break across words

grouping.sync: word-by-word reveal: a word appears (already yellow) when spoken, the previous word turns white on the same frame; words not yet spoken are hidden
grouping.break: new segment hard-replaces the old one when the 2-line block is full; breaks ignore sentence boundaries
grouping.gaps: band empty during pauses > ~15 frames and after the last spoken line

layout.align: each line centred; the segment's final layout is fixed before the first word shows, so words fill in place (a lone first word sits where it will end up, not centred)

normal.font_class: geometric sans, semibold (double-storey a, round o, angled t terminal)
normal.calibration_note: measured on the yellow state; white words are the same type and size

animation.word_entry: hard cut: each word appears at full size and opacity in yellow on its frame (no fade, pop or slide)
animation.highlight_move: the yellow hops word by word; the previous word turns white on the same frame (occasionally both yellow for 1 frame)
animation.timing: source is loosely synced auto-caption timing (-14 to +9 frames vs word start, median ~0); target 0 frames
animation.segment_change: hard cut to the next segment (old block disappears, first word of the new block appears in its final slot)
animation.exit: hard cut; band stays empty during pauses

text.copy: short CTA line + heart emoji + contact (placeholder 'Headline here <heart> @handle'), ~8 words

other_text_spec.animation: static from frame 0 to the end, not tracked

style.look_intent: natural office daylight, high-contrast but muted, slightly warm overall with cool overheads; neutral skin

sound.music: voice only in effect (speech covers 90 %); the heuristic flags a possible very low bed (gap level -28.4 dB under speech), so keep any bed inaudible
sfx: optional: faint camera-shutter clicks under the scrum opener

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

catalog_styles.name: Caption-Edit
catalog_styles.role: all editing happens in text; persistent CTA bar

catalog_styles.name: Long-Take Storytelling
catalog_styles.role: no cuts; the premise carries the runtime

use_when: the user has one continuous take of a speaker making a short announcement
the concept can be staged as a mini scene (press scrum, reveal, interview ambush)
a CTA (apply / DM / visit) must stay on screen the whole time
the face sits mid-frame so captions can live in the top band
avoid_when: the take runs well past the micro class with no visual change (it would need a cut or punch-in every 60-90 frames)
the top of the frame is busy or bright, hurting caption contrast
Hinglish delivery where emphasis words need bigger treatment
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B39 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B39.json) to this brand.
Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps. One continuous take; all editing is in the text layers.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{ACCENT}} must stay >= 3:1 on the footage in the top band, {{ACCENT_2}} >= 7:1 on {{CARD_BG}})
- {{TEXT}}: already-spoken caption words, default #FFFFFF
- {{ACCENT}}: the word being spoken, default #FECC00
- {{ACCENT_2}}: CTA bar text, default #000000
- {{SURFACE}}: unused, default none
- {{CARD_BG}}: CTA bar fill, default #FDFDFD
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}}: captions, default Poppins 600
- {{FONT_BODY}}: CTA bar text, default Poppins 600
- {{HANDLE}}: contact on the CTA bar (email, site or "@handle")
- {{LOGO}}: not shown in the source

CAPTIONS
1. Script & case: as spoken; lowercase except the first word of the video and proper nouns. Drop all punctuation (keep '@' and '.' inside {{HANDLE}}).
2. Grouping: segments of 4-7 words over at most 2 lines. Lay out the WHOLE segment first (each line centred on x ~51 %, max line width 71 % W), then reveal its words word by word in their final slots; the first word is not re-centred alone. When the 2 lines are full, hard-cut to the next segment (breaks may fall mid-sentence). Leave the band empty during pauses longer than ~15 frames.
3. {{FONT_DISPLAY}} 56 px for every word (no size change on the active word), tracking 0, no stroke, no box, soft shadow 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.35). Calibration: "positions" ink 3.05 % H / 24.6 % W; "locations" 2.19 % / 24.3 %.
4. Colours: word being spoken {{ACCENT}}; spoken words {{TEXT}}; unspoken words hidden.
5. Position: upper fifth, block centred at ~20 % H: line 1 ink 16.7-19.7 %, line 2 20.5-23.4 % (baseline pitch 3.6 % H); a 1-line segment centred in the band (~20.5 %). Keep the face (~38-55 %) and the CTA bar (~73 %) clear.
6. Animation: hard cut per word on its transcript start (0 frames); the highlight hops to the new word and the previous word turns {{TEXT}} on the same frame; no fade, pop, slide or idle motion; segment change is a hard cut.

OTHER TEXT
7. Persistent CTA bar, whole video: {{CARD_BG}} rounded rectangle (radius ~6 px), x 17.2-78.5 %, y 72.1-74.2 % (2.1 % H); centred {{ACCENT_2}} text "Headline here <heart emoji> {{HANDLE}}" (~8 words) in {{FONT_BODY}} 26 px (a 5-letter word reads ~0.86 % H; full line spans x 18.3-77.4 %). Static, not tracked.

EDIT
8. Single unbroken take, no cuts or punch-ins. Stage the opening as a scene (e.g. hands with phones and a mic pushed toward the speaker from the foreground); first word within 2-3 frames. Beat split: hook ~19 %, claim ~35 %, invitation question ~11 %, CTA ~20 %, sign-off ~15 %.

SOUND: voice only (any bed must be inaudible, > 25 dB under speech). Master to about -14.5 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP.
GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: natural office daylight, high-contrast but muted, slightly warm with cool overheads, neutral skin.

VERIFY before rendering: render the calibration words and measure them (yellow state):
  video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <render-file> --out <dir> --at <t_positions> --box 0.03,0.11,0.97,0.26 --ink "#FECC00:60"
  video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <render-file> --out <dir> --at <t_locations> --box 0.03,0.11,0.97,0.26 --ink "#FECC00:60"
"positions" must read ink 3.05 % +-0.5 of H and width 24.6 % +-2 of W; "locations" 2.19 % +-0.5 / 24.3 % +-2. Swap the --ink colour to {{ACCENT}}. Expected ink for any other word: video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py with {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 56 px. Positions within +-1 % of frame height.
